brief: Brackets for my car's roof bars that hold my kayak for a motorway drive to the coast.

requirements.evidence: 2x full cells (piece:0,0,0;full, piece:1,0,0;full) with 2x 1-in pipe saddles (accessory:0#0,0#1, accessory:0#1,0#1) intended as bar clamps; actual bar diameter and clamp fit not verified in configurator
requirements.requirement: Brackets that attach to car's roof bars

requirements.evidence: 2x L brackets (accessory:0#1,0#4, accessory:0#0,0#4) provide sideways shelves; no kayak-form cradle, straps, or kayak prop exists to show hold
requirements.requirement: Hold a kayak in the brackets

requirements.evidence: Parts are 3D printed in user-chosen material; configurator checks fit/collisions only (meshClash clear) and knows nothing about strength, load ratings, vibration, heat/UV resistance. Cannot verify motorway safety.
requirements.requirement: Safe for a motorway drive to the coast

finish.summary: Built a 2-cell joined base with two 1-in saddles for bar mounting and two L-brackets as kayak shelves; mesh clear. Motorway strength/safety is unverified and unmet — do not carry a kayak on public roads with printed parts without engineered, rated mounts.

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes
